purpose: Input contract for generating candidate sub-parameters without Cartesian explosion or fabricated scoring weights.

fields.parent_parameter_id: required native or candidate parameter id
fields.source_claim_ids: required non-empty list unless source gap is explicitly being recorded
fields.evidence_ids: list; may be empty only with epistemic status UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE and candidate remains non-validatable
fields.sequence_example_ids: list of Sequence instances where distinction was observed

generation_rule: At least one source-supported behavior difference must be TRUE before CANDIDATE_SPLIT can be emitted. UNKNOWN values do not count as positive evidence. No numeric total is computed until weights are explicitly defined.
